title: Listening Drill — Local tree identification — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Local tree identification — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on local tree identification last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with similar leaves. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: missing tag.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of leaf margins so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow hand lens instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the tree officer before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Thursday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
